brief:
Gaza's municipal authority warned of complete failure in the city's sewage infrastructure, citing extensive damage to treatment plants and drainage networks, Shehab Wire reported. The municipality cautioned that deteriorating conditions pose mounting health and environmental risks to residents and marine ecosystems.

The warning comes as Gaza faces accelerating infrastructure damage across multiple sectors. Treatment facilities and distribution lines have sustained widespread destruction, leaving the municipality unable to manage waste flows effectively. Officials flagged cascading public health threats from contaminated water and sewage overflow, along with ongoing degradation of coastal waters that depend on proper waste management systems.
